name: Nomad 3
notes: Price from the official US store (no EU store; HDPE, grey HDPE or bamboo enclosure, same price). Includes MeshCAM for Nomad, Alibre Workshop licence, Carbide Create/Motion, BitZero V2 probe, 1/8 in ER-11 collet and two end mills. Weight is 70 lb per the Nomad 3 Getting Started Guide (older carbide3d.com/nomad text says 65 lb). Linear guides: round-rod linear bearings on X/Y, HG15 linear rails on Z. Integrated BitSetter tool-length sensor; BitZero V2 is a corner/XYZ probe block, not a spindle touch probe. Door interlock. Successor Nomad 4 is sold alongside (USD 5,400).

accessories.name: Low Profile Vise
accessories.description: In-house made vise for the Nomad (2 in wide, 8 in long, 6.5 in max clamping width) with hardware to mount it to the table.

accessories.name: Nomad Flip Jig
accessories.description: Precision fixture that mounts on the Nomad 3 table to machine both sides of a part (stock just under 3 x 5 in, up to 1.2 in thick) with alignment.

accessories.name: Nomad Threaded Table
accessories.description: Approx. 1/2 in thick table with over 50 M6 threaded holes, incl. clamps and screws, for more workholding options.

accessories.name: Carbide 3D Jog Pendant
accessories.description: USB handheld jog pendant with jog wheel, continuous-jog, feedhold/start and software E-stop buttons for Nomad/Shapeoko running Carbide Motion.
